# 3ASY

> 3ASY is the software line by 3FE DEV, the development team at 3FESTO SRL, an independent Italian technology company based in Bologna. The current portfolio is deliberately small: two operational products and two public experimental projects.

## Official entities

- 3ASY website (Italian, canonical): https://www.3asy.it/
- 3ASY website (English): https://www.3asy.it/en/
- 3FE DEV: the software development team at 3FESTO
- Legal publisher: 3FESTO SRL, Bologna, Emilia-Romagna, Italy
- Parent company: https://www.3festo.com/
- Industrial product line: https://www.any3dp.com/
- Public source: https://github.com/3FESTO/3ASY-LANDING
- Contact: info@3festo.com

## Products

- [3HR](https://www.3hr.it/): **In operational use.** A workspace for attendance, calendar-based timesheets, leave approvals, company device inventory, and cost and margin visibility by resource. It is used across three companies and more than 30 people.
- [3BNB](https://bnb.3asy.app/): **Selected beta.** A guided month-end workflow for short-term-rental property managers. It reads mixed source documents, flags anomalies, applies explicit allocation rules, and prepares owner reports. Public launch is planned for January 1, 2027.

## Public projects

- [3ASYRESEARCH](https://research.3asy.app/): **Early experiment.** Research papers turned into plain-language explanations and interactive tools. Two live cases cover hybrid TPMS structures and MJF production-cost modelling.
- [3ASYGIT](https://git.3asy.app/): **Public experiment.** Public GitHub contribution histories turned into explorable 3D cities, solar systems, and speed circuits.

## Product principles

- 3HR and 3BNB are the only products in the current 3ASY offer.
- 3ASYRESEARCH and 3ASYGIT are projects, not commercial product claims.
- AI is used where it supports a clear workflow; explicit, deterministic rules are used where control and traceability matter.
- Product maturity and access differ: 3HR is available through a focused demo, while 3BNB is in a selected beta.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-30
